authority.live_resource_validation: the registered mac-14 resource must pass the exact remote preflight before mutation
authority.credentials_policy: references only; secrets are never stored in Git

database_administration_binding.purpose: bind fresh-only P0-E databases to lease-bound remote administration
database_administration_binding.owner: Peanut Admin P0-E project-resource lease owner
database_administration_binding.data_source: resources/project-resources.json plus the live registered mac-14 resource
database_administration_binding.freshness_requirement: after claim and before mutation, both project registries and the live resource must agree on the resource, image, endpoint and version
database_administration_binding.cleanup_responsibility: the active P0-E lease owner drops only its exact run_id databases

tooling.owner: Peanut Admin project; consumes the registered mac-14 MySQL allocation
tooling.service_type: MySQL CLI inside the allocated database container over SSH docker exec
tooling.credential_ref: the registered container's MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD environment; never transferred to the workstation
tooling.data_source: live Peanut Admin resource peanut-admin-mysql84-development on mac-14
tooling.freshness_requirement: after claim and before any database mutation, verify the exact container image, running/healthy state and MySQL CLI version
tooling.fallback: none; host mysql commands are forbidden
tooling.cleanup_responsibility: not applicable; the tooling runs inside the existing persistent allocation
